hook: Hoffman co-founded LinkedIn in 2002 and later became a partner at Greylock in 2009. He was a financial backer named in OpenAI's founding announcement in December 2015, later joined OpenAI's board in 2018, and left that board in March 2023. In 2022 he co-founded Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman and Karen Simonyan.
name: Reid Hoffman

quote.text: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, with more than one billion members.

moniker: Co-founder, LinkedIn and Inflection AI, Partner at Greylock

timeline.impact: Launches the company publicly on May 5, 2003
Begins investing in early-stage technology companies

timeline.event: Named a financial backer in OpenAI's founding announcement
timeline.impact: Becomes one of OpenAI's initial funders alongside Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Peter Thiel
Serves on the board following Elon Musk's departure

timeline.event: Co-founds Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman and Karen Simonyan
timeline.impact: Launches a new AI software company
Cites a wish to avoid conflicts among his AI-related investments and roles
